decision: D1: How should /events lay out the team's featured picks and the partner event list?
invariants: same live Supabase events (51 partner events) and the same 3 sample featured picks
same copy from the Web Design Proposal doc
same card anatomy (web-app EventCard) in landing brand tokens
same chip filters, calendar and partner sidebar

options.bet: Image-led: one large lead featured card + two supporting; partner events as a 2-col card grid
options.benefit: Richest imagery, closest to the reference, familiar
options.cost: Long page at ~50 cards; dates are hard to scan
options.risk: Reads as a generic events grid

options.bet: Time-first: featured on the hero's ink band; partner events as an agenda grouped This week / Next week / month, synced with the calendar
options.benefit: Matches how people choose events; scales to 50+ on mobile; calendar and list are one system
options.risk: Can read dense if spacing slips

options.bet: The picks are the hero: headline left, featured stack right; stats strip below; 3-col grid
options.benefit: Featured is the first thing seen at every width
options.cost: Photo loses its role; sidebar squeezes the grid
options.risk: Busy hero; featured may look like an ad
